app_tagline: [বাংলা] Speak your problem. We find your scheme.
consent_body: [বাংলা] We collect only minimum details to match you with government schemes. Voice recordings are kept securely for 30 days and then automatically deleted. You can delete your data at any time from Settings.
mode_selection_title: [বাংলা] How would you like to use Umeed?
mode_text_badge: [বাংলা] For those who can read and type
mode_text_subtitle: [বাংলা] Type your details in a familiar form.
mode_audio_prompt: [বাংলা] Press the orange button to speak, or the blue button to type.
q_gender: [বাংলা] Are you a woman, a man, or other?
q_state: [বাংলা] Which state do you live in?
q_area: [বাংলা] Do you live in a village or a city?
q_caste: [বাংলা] Which category do you belong to? (General, OBC, SC, ST). You may skip this.
q_income: [বাংলা] About how much does your family earn in a year?
q_occupation: [বাংলা] What work do you do? (Farmer, student, laborer, homemaker, business, other)
q_disability: [বাংলা] Do you have any disability? You may skip this.
q_family: [বাংলা] How many people live in your family?
q_need: [বাংলা] What kind of help do you need most? (Farming, education, health, housing, money, jobs)
caste_why: [বাংলা] Certain government schemes provide special grants, subsidies, or reservations specifically for SC, ST, or OBC categories.
income_why: [বাংলা] Many schemes are meant for families below specific income limits or BPL thresholds.
disability_why: [বাংলা] Special pensions, assistive devices, and quotas exist for persons with disabilities.
handoff_title: [বাংলা] Your recordings have reached a helper
handoff_desc: [বাংলা] A trained civic helper is reviewing your voice responses to complete your profile.
busy_day_desc: [বাংলা] Our helpers are currently busy. We have scheduled a confirmed callback slot for you tomorrow.
reminder_scheduled: [বাংলা] We will send an SMS and notification 15 minutes before your slot.
profile_ready_notification: [বাংলা] Your profile is ready! Tap to view your ranked schemes.
docs_locked_notice: [বাংলা] Documents unlock after speaking to the Help Desk or choosing to skip.
skip_help_desk: [বাংলা] I already understand, skip to documents
physical_office_address: [বাংলা] Or visit nearby CSC / Gram Panchayat office
no_proxy_notice: [বাংলা] Umeed does not submit applications on your behalf. We guide you to the official window.
delete_data_confirm: [বাংলা] Are you sure? This will erase your profile and cached voice recordings immediately.
disclaimer: [বাংলা] Disclaimer: Umeed is an informational and guidance tool. Final eligibility and approvals are decided solely by the respective government authority.
q_sector_focus: [bn] Which area or sector do you need help in? (Finance, Agriculture, Health, Housing, Education, Jobs, Pension)
choose_gist_language: [bn] In which language would you like your scheme summary and gist?
query_help_desk: [bn] Have a question about this scheme? Ask the Help Desk
type_query_hint: [bn] Type or speak your question for the helper...
